_meta.openai/annotationJustification: Runs SEO/accessibility-style checks on a page for pre-publish validation.

description: Pre-publish lint (tags, assets, layout, SEO, speed and accessibility). Summary first: health issues grouped by code, each with fix:{tool,args,fill?} — supply the fill args, then call. health.summary counts are whole-site (groups/codes filter only issues and assets). Pair with preview_page — see get_skill('verify').

codes.description: Only these health codes, e.g. perf_image_heavy.

context.description: One sentence: why you are calling this tool and what you are trying to accomplish. Stored on the site's activity log and visible to everyone on the site — never put secrets or personal data here.

detail.description: summary (default): grouped by code, clean pages counted. full: per-page lists.

groups.description: Only these groups: speed = perf_*, a11y = a11y_*, links = link_* + content_*. Omit for all.

guestToken.description: Guest token from start_site. Send it on every call until claim_site. Omit when this chat is already signed in to Dotsy.

paths.description: Routes to check; omit to verify every route on the site.

name: verify_page
